articles.summary: MetalRT delivers 658 tok/s decode and 6.6ms time-to-first-token, winning decode on 3 of 4 models we tested on a single M4 Max.
articles.title: We Built the Fastest LLM Decode Engine for Apple Silicon. Here Are the Numbers.

articles.summary: MetalRT adds VLM support and wins every decode benchmark. 279 tok/s vision decode, 92ms time-to-output, 1.22x faster than mlx-vlm across all resolutions on a single M4 Max.
articles.title: MetalRT Now Runs Vision Language Models. Fastest on Apple Silicon.

articles.summary: MetalRT adds native speech-to-speech support. 1.68s end-to-end latency, 123 tok/s generation throughput, 1.52x faster than mlx-audio on a single M4 Max.
articles.title: MetalRT Now Does Speech-to-Speech. 1.52x Faster Than mlx-audio.

articles.summary: MetalRT becomes the first inference engine to handle LLMs, Speech-to-Text, and Text-to-Speech on Apple Silicon. 101ms to transcribe 70 seconds of audio. 178ms to synthesize speech. 4.6x faster than Apple MLX.
articles.title: MetalRT: The First Complete AI Inference Engine for Apple Silicon. Now with Speech.

articles.summary: A deep-dive into how PickleRite — a pickleball performance tracker — runs a specialized LLM entirely on-device using RunAnywhere SDK. Zero cloud costs, full offline support, complete privacy.
articles.title: How RunAnywhere SDK Powers On-Device AI Coaching in PickleRite
